# Orleans.FSharp (Full Context)

Project homepage: https://neftedollar.com/orleans-fsharp/
Project repository: https://github.com/Neftedollar/orleans-fsharp
Primary language: F#
Runtime target: .NET 10 and Microsoft Orleans 10 parity
License: MIT

## Summary
Orleans.FSharp provides an idiomatic F# developer surface over Microsoft Orleans.
It emphasizes computation-expression based authoring (`siloConfig {}`, `clientConfig {}`, `eventSourcedGrain {}`),
immutable state transitions, typed message flows, and reduced C# boilerplate.

Grain authoring has two models. The current one is the functional grain runtime
(`grainContract` / `grainFor` / `FunctionalGrain.ref` / `AddFunctionalGrain`).
The original `grain {}` computation expression and its `FSharpGrain.*` handle module still compile
and run, but their public surface now carries `[<Obsolete>]` (warning, not error); new code should
use the functional runtime. See https://neftedollar.com/orleans-fsharp/functional-grains/ for the
before/after mapping of every deprecated entry point.

## Key Claims
- Orleans 10 parity
- 1500+ tests (unit and integration)
- Support for serialization, streaming, event sourcing, reentrancy, placement, transactions, TLS/mTLS, health checks, OpenTelemetry, and Kubernetes clustering
